Meta.title: {brand}: personalized stories starring your child
Meta.description: Create a one-of-a-kind children's book with your child's name, face and favorite things. Free preview, digital or printed book shipped to your country.

hero.title: A story where your child is the hero
hero.subtitle: With their name, their face and the things they love. See a free preview and get the book as a PDF or printed and delivered to your door.

trust.privacy: Photos protected and deleted after 30 days

how.title: It's that easy
how.subtitle: A one-of-a-kind book in less than 10 minutes.
how.step1Text: Their name, age, favorite things and 1 to 3 photos. Pick the story and the illustration style.
how.step2Text: We create the cover and two pages starring your child. You can edit the text and change the photo.
how.step3Text: Download the PDF instantly or get it printed in softcover or hardcover.

gallery.title: Stories for every dream
gallery.subtitle: Pick the adventure they'll love the most.

guarantee.title: If you don't love it, you don't pay
guarantee.text: You see the preview before paying. And if your book arrives with a problem, we'll reprint it or refund you.

cta.title: Give a memory that lasts a lifetime
cta.text: A birthday, Christmas or just any Tuesday: every day is a good day to be the hero.
